tools.name: draft_post
tools.description: Write a build in public post for X about work the user just did, in their own voice (Loudcode knows their product, tone and past posts). Pass a concrete summary of what was built or changed in this session: features, fixes, decisions, numbers, and why it matters to users. Returns the draft (and alte

tools.name: list_drafts
tools.description: List the user's Loudcode drafts waiting for review, and posts queued to go out, with their ids.

tools.name: queue_post
tools.description: Queue a Loudcode draft to post to the user's X account: at their next free posting slot, or at a specific time. Only do this when the user asked to queue or schedule it.

tools.name: post_metrics
tools.description: How the user's recent X posts did: views, likes, replies per post and totals, best post first.

tools.name: list_ideas
tools.description: Post ideas Loudcode found in the user's product, numbers, posts and repo. Good when they shipped nothing new this week.

tools.name: weekly_checkin
tools.description: Do the user's weekly check-in from what you know about their week, and Loudcode plans a week of posts (saved as drafts with suggested times, not posted). Answer each question concretely; leave one empty if you don't know.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_drafts, list_ideas, weekly_checkin · Public sink: draft_post, queue_post, post_metrics, list_ideas.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_drafts, list_ideas, weekly_checkin · Public sink: draft_post, queue_post, post_metrics, list_ideas

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
